verdicts.reason: A: the bottom-right row is jammed. The '25% off on June 21.' subhead wraps awkwardly next to the CTA, and the legal text is set almost as large as the subhead, so it competes for attention and sits right against the right edge. The phone runs into the top edge, and the cropped circles behind the logo look accidental. B has a cleaner hierarchy, reading from headline to subhead to CTA, but it still has flaws. The logo is shrunk to near-illegibility, there is dead space between the subhead and the CTA, the legal line is unreadably tiny, and the right circle crowds the CTA.
